image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a metallic green tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) resting on a dark, textured, rocky surface. The beetle exhibits iridescent emerald green elytra with distinct cream-colored spots. Its head is broad with large compound eyes and visible mandibles. Six slender legs are visible, gripping the uneven terrain. Antennae are thin and extend outward.
